# Area

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

An ongoing sphere of responsibility or activity with a standard to be maintained over time, without a defined completion date.

## Scope note

Per the PARA method; distinct from Project (has an end state) and Interest (topic without an ownership obligation).
